status: Frozen before comparison outcomes; a new experiment, not a historical reproduction
plant_protocol: Unchanged experiments/fourier_online.py CONFIG: 80 seconds, dt=0.01, complete-feature secant window=0.05, known phase_rate=4, measured-rate Gaussian noise sd=0.001, unchanged RK4 and reference
family_and_gauge: All methods K=1 six free coefficients, supplied coefficient of -u fixed at1; identical initial coefficients, bounds, scales, calibrated zero level, and observed channels

methods.memory_pg: Original ImplicitLearner: exponential memory8 seconds and8 projected-gradient iterations with reciprocal-trace step per sample
methods.memory_ewls: Same exponential covariance objective and constraints, solved with scipy.optimize.lsq_linear(method=bvls,tol=1e-10,max_iter=100) using symmetric eigendecomposition square root of7x7 covariance; negative roundoff eigenvalues clipped at0; no ridge, no truth access
methods.instant_nlms: One projected normalized stochastic-gradient step, gain1, normalization max(squared norm of scaled free observed channels,1e-12); memory-free update ablation; same exponential covariance retained only for common diagnostic scoring

primary: All three estimators are causal shadows on original memory_pg controller trajectory; common observations and complete-feature secants; score with current coefficients before current assimilation
secondary: memory_ewls and instant_nlms separately control own plant trajectories with otherwise identical configurations and per-seed noise draws; memory_pg primary trajectory is its own control branch
evaluation_window: 60 <= t <80 seconds (same late window as main paper); retain full traces for transient inspection
metrics: scaled complete evaluated differential relative error including clock
learned-only scaled differential relative error excluding fixed -1
numerical KKT residual and solver failures
own-trajectory tracking RMSE and control RMS
evaluation_boundary: Clean actual rate, true coefficients, true evaluated partials and oracle energy are evaluator-only; no derivative targets or clean signals enter estimators; references are controller inputs only
interpretation: EWLS is an alternative numerical estimator of the same convex objective, not a new model family; instantaneous NLMS changes both memory and optimizer. No superiority, held-out generalization, frequency discovery, unrestricted learning or closed-loop stability claim is presumed
compute: One sequential process; all ten seeds and method failures retained; no tuning based on outcomes
validation_plan: BVLS checked against a known box optimum and independent constrained optimizer
full covariance objective checked against explicit weighted history
same-stream PG trajectory matches original simulate
preupdate timing and frozen final update
unknown-only differential error excludes fixed coefficient
